inputs.text: Local organizers in southern Alberta are collecting signatures to block coal mining, with the goal of protecting the watershed. Water Not Coal, started by Corb Lund last month, is advancing a citizen initiative petition to force the Government of Alberta to “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration.” This represents a community-led challenge to the entrenched coal and energy industries that have long prioritized resource extraction and corporate gains over the health of water systems and the stability of vulnerable populations. Rather than defending outdated industry interests and traditional authority structures that perpetuate inequality, this petition pushes for institutional reform to safeguard public resources and prevent further harm to communities.
